name: daftari
description: A persistent cortex Claude reads, writes, and curates over time.
long_description: An external cortex for AI agents: a persistent markdown vault that agents read, write, and curate over time. Plain text on disk, git-versioned, indexed for BM25 + vector search. Agents promote drafts to canonical knowledge, surface contradictions as tensions, and lint for staleness. Runs offline by default.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to the daftari vault directory.

user.title: User
user.description: Your identity for provenance tracking (e.g. 'mihir'). Recorded on every write.

role.title: Role
role.description: Your role as defined in .daftari/config.yaml (e.g. 'admin', 'analyst'). Determines read/write permissions per collection.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key. Required only if the vault's embeddings.provider is set to openai-3-small. Used solely for embedding generation; leave blank for the default local provider.

tools.name: vault_read
tools.description: Read a single vault document.

tools.name: vault_index
tools.description: List vault documents with their metadata, including each document's questions_answered / questions_raised.

tools.name: vault_status
tools.description: Vault health dashboard: the running daftari version, total file count, per-collection counts, count of documents with invalid frontmatter, a staleness distribution (fresh/aging/stale), unresolved tensions, and recent write history.

tools.name: vault_receipt
tools.description: Compile an epistemic receipt for the vault documents an answer relies on.

tools.name: vault_canon
tools.description: Compute settled vs contested belief over a depth-bounded topic graph seeded at `seed`.

tools.name: vault_witness
tools.description: Per-principal track records aggregated from the vault's own ledgers (provenance log, tension log, staged actions), priced by the wager schedule: writing a claim at a confidence level stakes points (low 0 / medium 1 / high 3, provisional); a claim later corrected or retired burns the stake; a claim maintained through a full TTL cycle earns credit.

tools.name: vault_search
tools.description: Hybrid search across the vault: BM25 lexical ranking combined with vector semantic similarity.

tools.name: vault_search_related
tools.description: Find documents related to a given vault document.

tools.name: vault_reindex
tools.description: Rebuild the search index from the markdown files on disk.

tools.name: vault_themes
tools.description: Surface thematic clusters across the vault using k-means over CHUNK embeddings, with per-document theme distributions.

tools.name: vault_write
tools.description: Create a new vault document or overwrite an existing one.

tools.name: vault_append
tools.description: Append a markdown section to an existing vault document.

tools.name: vault_promote
tools.description: Promote a draft document to canonical status.

tools.name: vault_deprecate
tools.description: Mark a document deprecated.

tools.name: vault_set_confidence
tools.description: Change only a document's confidence level (low | medium | high), leaving its status and body untouched.

tools.name: vault_set_tier
tools.description: Change only a document's write-protection tier (source | compiled | manual), leaving its body untouched.

tools.name: vault_supersede
tools.description: Mark a document superseded by a named successor.

tools.name: vault_merge
tools.description: Combine two source documents into a target and supersede both sources to point at it, all in one commit.

tools.name: vault_assert
tools.description: Assert, dispute, or qualify the calling principal's position on an existing claim document.

tools.name: vault_positions
tools.description: Query positions: all positions on one doc ('path'), or all live positions held by a principal across the vault ('principal').

tools.name: vault_consolidate
tools.description: Ratify the org's consolidated stance on a claim document (ratify-gated: requires a role with ratify: true; propose-only roles are denied outright — there is no staged-proposal path for consolidation).

tools.name: vault_tension_log
tools.description: Record a tension — a contradiction or unresolved pull between two vault documents — to the advisory tension log.

tools.name: vault_tension_resolve
tools.description: Record the closure of a previously logged tension.

tools.name: vault_tension_clusters
tools.description: Compute connected components of the tension graph: groups of vault documents joined transitively by unresolved tensions.

tools.name: vault_tension_blast
tools.description: Compute the transitive closure of downstream documents that cite or link a contested document — or the union over a contested cluster.

tools.name: vault_tension_triage
tools.description: Compose the vault's LIVE tensions into a human-legible triage card: every unresolved, non-accepted tension grouped by cluster and annotated for a curator deciding what to resolve.

tools.name: vault_lint
tools.description: Run the advisory curation checks across the vault: stale files past TTL, orphan files with no inbound links, old drafts, stagnant low-confidence files, deprecated files still linked from canonical ones, and questions raised but unanswered anywhere in the vault.

tools.name: vault_provenance
tools.description: Return the write history of a single document from the provenance log: every create, update, append, promote, and deprecate recorded for it, oldest first.

tools.name: vault_stage_action
tools.description: Record a proposed change to the vault for later human ratification via vault_ratify.

tools.name: vault_ratify
tools.description: Approve or reject a single pending staged action.

tools.name: vault_edge_observe
tools.description: Record that a (re-)derivation observed a derives_from edge between two documents.

tools.name: vault_edge_contest
tools.description: Record a case-2 contradiction: a re-derivation failed with no upstream change.

tools.name: vault_edges
tools.description: List derives_from edges with their live aged strength, strongest first.

tools.name: vault_consumes
tools.description: Query the compiled consumes graph (#233): edges minted mechanically from run correlation — a write carrying a run_id consumes every document the same run read beforehand.

tools.name: vault_backlinks
tools.description: The reverse of the knowledge graph: given a target, list the documents that reference it.

tools.name: vault_tier1
tools.description: Deterministic, LLM-free compatibility dispatch for a changed document (#232 tier 1).

tools.name: vault_tier2_queue
tools.description: The tier-2 semantic-review queue (#232): every declared/earned dependency whose upstream changed but whose compatibility the structure could not decide (tier 1's residual — #234's pending-unchecked class), minus pairs an existing verdict already covers.

tools.name: vault_tier2_verdict
tools.description: Record the answer to a vault_tier2_queue item (#232 tier 2).

tools.name: vault_staleness
tools.description: Edge staleness (#234): is a document stale WITH RESPECT TO its upstream inputs, and does it matter?

tools.name: vault_board_list
tools.description: List all current board findings, grouped by disposition column (new / accepted / waiting / resolved / dismissed).

tools.name: vault_board_dispose
tools.description: Record a human disposition decision on a board finding.

tools.name: vault_board_resolve
tools.description: Deterministically verify that a finding no longer reproduces, and if so write a system-authored 'resolved' event.
